meta.name: design-taste-frontend-v1
meta.description: The original v1 taste-skill, preserved for projects depending on its exact behavior. The current default is `design-taste-frontend` (v2 experimental), which is a substantial rewrite. Use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照一套严格的设计规则生成前端代码，包括字体、颜色、布局、动效等，并自动检查依赖包是否安装。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成 React 或 Next.js 前端代码时触发，尤其是涉及 UI 设计、布局或动效的场景。

say.text: 帮我做一个登录页面，用 Tailwind CSS。
设计一个仪表盘，包含数据表格和图表。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates frontend code following strict design rules for typography, color, layout, motion, etc., and automatically checks if dependencies are installed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate React or Next.js frontend code, especially for UI design, layout, or motion.

say_en.text: Create a login page using Tailwind CSS.
Design a dashboard with data tables and charts.
